verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a SaaS phone platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Quo's source code published under an open license. The downloadable OpenAPI specification is an API description, not product source, so it is adjacent at most and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
